scope: Independent offline premise review before new v14 source/build qualification; no hardware, build, test or source edit.
result: The proposed masked request formula matches a concrete native release operation; it is a bounded experiment rather than a complete native lifecycle replay.

mapping.native_release: FW1b1f0 reads SGX211c8;1b1f4 computes request&0xfffffffffffffffe;1b1f8 supplies expected acknowledgement0;1b1fc calls32104.
mapping.native_write: FW32138 writes full supplied request to SGX211c8.
mapping.native_ack: FW32178..32184 tests only211d0 bit0; bit1 is ignored.
mapping.proposal: For a fresh exact request3, request&~1 produces2 and preserves every other bit. No ACK write, bit1 clear or extra notification is justified.
mapping.counterexample_limit: Current ACK2 already satisfies native release lowbit expectation0. A matching readback/ACK alone therefore cannot prove that a scheduling pause was lifted or GPU work progressed.

eligibility_review.own_pipeline: Exact fresh cold root, own fresh control33, one accepted two-record TA/3D draw; matching context, PA, job, source/module and backing identities.
eligibility_review.fresh_state: At the source-owned100ms observation: request211c8=3, ACK211d0=2, enabled masks21038/21040=3/0, valid freshly zero fault information and address, exact four completion configurations, held live PM/allocations.
eligibility_review.final_read: Derive the formula from a final fresh request read after guards and require it still equals3; prior cached sample alone cannot preserve subsequently changed bits. All operand reads remain nonatomic.
eligibility_review.progress: Skip/refuse the intervention if target/software/hardware completion already progressed at the eligibility sample; this tests the saved stalled state.
eligibility_review.once: One marked attempt and at most one request write in a distinct fresh-boot family; unknown/partial/interrupted history prevents another control. Retain all backing and PM after any outcome.
eligibility_review.later_review: Source and host implementation remain pending; these checks are review expectations, not claims of implemented behavior.

uncertainty_and_risks.native_owner: Native release clears bit0 only after clearing its own13f018 reason under mutex and finding the remaining reasonword zero. The experiment cannot establish that precondition from saved startup-only traces; it bypasses native reason ownership.
uncertainty_and_risks.race: The host has no native firmware mutex. Firmware may be editing queues or may overwrite request state after the masked write; final fresh reads narrow but do not eliminate this race.
uncertainty_and_risks.different_wait: The distinct1a994 path waits ACKbit1 clear. A3-to2 request preserves bit1 and does not directly test that separate wait.
uncertainty_and_risks.execution: No current firmware PC/final DATA is available. Native scene/resource/UAT/shader prerequisites remain unproven. A negative result cannot exclude every scheduling theory; a positive result requires job-bound completion and output evidence.

allowed_interpretation: Observe whether this single native-formula request-bit0 intervention changes the exact accepted-draw result. Report raw request/ACK, bounded observations, target/completion changes and faults; do not report helper success as execution.
